description: Call when a user asks for the food science, the culture and history, and the cooking views on one food question together. Foodbe looks up the question in its library of human-approved answers and returns the answer as "headline", plus the views of three experts: Neuro (food science), Oracle (culture and history) and Chefy (cooking tips and tricks). The response lists sources as web links, each with a text and a url. "sources" holds the sources of the answer, and each expert has its own "emoji" and "sources". When the question names a food Foodbe has a photo for, it also returns "image_url", a link to that photo, unless include_image is false. Set include_sources to false to leave the source links out. An expert with nothing approved for the question is left out. Also returns related follow-up questions, when it has them. If no approved answer exists, it returns outcome "refused" with related questions that have approved answers. A limited number of calls work without a key. After that, a key is needed in the x-foodbe-key header.

include_image.description: Optional. A link to a photo of the food the question names is returned by default. Set false to leave it out.

include_sources.description: Optional. The source links are returned by default. Set false to leave them out.

name: foodbe_query_all
